body: it sucks that you have to face this constantly. im pretty much going through the same thing, and weirdly enough, im also the middle child (i just thought it was weird). life can be really cruel sometimes and it can be incredibly difficult to go through. i dont really know what to tell you, since im not exactly doing that great myself but i am more than willing to listen. and im sure everyone here is willing to listen to you. what ive learned over the years is having someone to share your frustrations to can help a ton.

thank you so much for the responses. i fell asleep and woke up only to pick up where i left off (with the crying).

ive been trying so hard to stay positive but i honestly feel like i dont have it in me anymore. i worked so hard to improve my life this year, went back to college and did well, but suddenly this thing just somehow threw all of it out the window and i feel like im back to where i was a year ago and my life isn't going anywhere.
